text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the Marlowe postmortem. We traced the tenant isolation blips to a timing window where our peering agent re-announced prefixes while the customer	(on-prem appliance) still had stale conntrack entries, causing transient asymmetric forwarding. Need owners for remediation, CI validation, monitoring, and customer coordination. Assigning below.

sanjay: I can take peering-agent changes. Proposal: add a 30s graceful suppress on re-announces and a route dedupe pass in the prop job. Also add a safety that withdraws a route if flap rate > 4/5m. Will open PR + rollback notes. ETA: Wed EOD.

lena: Ill run on-prem audit with Marlowe ops. Checklist: conntrack dumps, NAT timeouts, firmware/kernel versions, and iptables snapshots. If vendor firmware is implicated we escalate. Need Marlowe maintenance window.

arjun: I'll own CI validation and blueprints. Plan: create an e2e that simulates asymmetric paths and conntrack churn (no customer infra touched; we mock appliances). Add a nightly chaos job against dedicated staging. ETA: next Fri.

vika: Intro DM to Marlowe ops sent and added their point of contact to INC-5312. Filed ticket and suggested two maintenance windows.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5312 "Marlowe conntrack/peering drift investigation"  assignee: net-ops  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5312

marta: Monitoring asks: 1) Grafana panel for per-peer route_flap_rate 2) conntrack_reassoc ratio for Marlowe 3) dup_forwarded_packets metric. Alert conditions: route_flap_rate > 3/5m OR conntrack_reassoc > 0.7% OR dup_forwarded_packets > 0.05% in 5m. @sanjay please add panel + alerts and wire to #incidents + pager on critical.

sanjay: Will add panels. Starting queries: 
```
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer=\"marlowe\"}[5m])) by (peer)
```
and
```
sum(rate(conntrack_reassoc_total{customer=\"marlowe\"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(conntrack_total{customer=\"marlowe\"}[5m])))
```
Also exposing dup_forwarded_packets from edge-proxy as discussed. Slack notif + page on threshold.

lena: FYI Marlowe has a mix of vendor images; one model on fw 2.1 has known NAT rebind behavior. Vendor says patch ETA ~3 weeks. I'll capture exact versions in INC-5312 and propose a pruning shim as short-term mitigation.

arjun: For CI test I'll include a recorded packet-timing replay from the incident trace so we catch regressions. I will also add a flag to run the test in PRs touching peering logic.

marta: Action summary (added to postmortem doc):
1) sanjay 	 route suppress (30s) + dedupe + alerting (PR -> #PR-1003) 	 ETA Wed EOD
2) lena 	 on-prem audit + vendor escalation (INC-5312) 	 ETA Mon next week
3) arjun 	 CI/blueprints e2e + nightly chaos 	 ETA Fri next week
4) vika 	 customer coordination + maintenance sign-off 	 ETA tomorrow
5) add monitoring dash + dup metric (owner: sanjay) 	 ETA Thu

marta: Please update INC-5312 with milestones and drop PR/CI links when ready. 15m sync scheduled Tue 09:30 PT to confirm progress. Thanks :white_check_mark:
